entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: North to northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Winds easing from the south during Friday afternoon and evening. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 70 to 100 mm of rain. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: In addition to what has already fallen, expect 100 to 140 mm of rain about the ranges, and 30 to 60 mm nearer the coast, possibly more in localised areas. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected about the ranges. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: On top of what has already fallen, expect 100 to 140 mm of rain about the main divide, and 70 to 100 mm within 20 km farther east, possibly more in localised areas. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Friday morning about the divide. Freezing level 2200 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
